MutationContext.description: Metadata every mutation must carry so retries and stale edits are safe.

auto_close_sub_issues.description: Close an open parent automatically once every sub-issue is closed (Linear's "auto-close parent issues").

close_sub_issues_with_parent.description: Close a parent's open sub-issues when the parent closes (Linear's "auto-close sub-issues"): a completed parent completes them, and a canceled or duplicate parent cancels them.
